mentions.name: Grain of Salt
mentions.description: A graph-based recipe app for storing and organizing personal recipes. Planned graph features include linking two users' recipe trees when they were imported via the same URL, plus standard recipe-app niceties like nested recipes, temperature conversions, and converting volumetric ingredient amounts to mass. The author is dogfooding it to add new recipes and convert old recipes written in the margins to this format.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on / dog fooding my graph based recipe app[0].
mentions.author: philajan
